import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch, Arc
mpl.rcParams.update({ "text.usetex": False, "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "font.size": 12, "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "text.color": "#263238", "lines.linewidth": 1.6, "svg.fonttype": "path", })
INK = "#263238" BLUE = "#33658A" TEAL = "#2A9D8F" SLATE = "#657786"
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(6.2, 4.2)) ax = fig.add_axes([0.045, 0.08, 0.615, 0.86]) ax.set_aspect("equal") ax.set_xlim(-0.30, 4.35) ax.set_ylim(-0.30, 4.15) ax.axis("off")
def arrow(axis, start, end, color=INK, linewidth=1.6, mutation_scale=12, linestyle="-", zorder=3): patch = FancyArrowPatch( start, end, arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=mutation_scale, linewidth=linewidth, color=color, linestyle=linestyle, shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0, zorder=zorder, ) axis.add_patch(patch) return patch
# Schematic geometry only: coordinates set the drawing, not measured data. origin = np.array([0.0, 0.0]) particle = np.array([2.72, 2.24]) theta = np.arctan2(particle[1], particle[0]) er = np.array([np.cos(theta), np.sin(theta)]) etheta = np.array([-np.sin(theta), np.cos(theta)])
arrow(ax, origin, [4.08, 0], linewidth=1.15, mutation_scale=10) arrow(ax, origin, [0, 3.92], linewidth=1.15, mutation_scale=10) ax.text(4.15, -0.02, r"$x$", va="center") ax.text(-0.02, 4.04, r"$y$", ha="center") ax.text(-0.10, -0.12, r"$O$", ha="right", va="top")
# Smooth illustrative particle trajectory passing through the selected point. t = np.linspace(-1.65, 1.42, 240) curve_x = particle[0] + 0.68*t - 0.17*t**2 curve_y = particle[1] + 0.70*t + 0.15*t**2 ax.plot(curve_x, curve_y, color=SLATE, linewidth=1.5, zorder=1)
arrow(ax, origin, particle, BLUE, linewidth=1.9, mutation_scale=14) ax.text(*(0.51*particle + 0.20*etheta), r"$\mathbf{r}$", color=BLUE, ha="center", va="center") ax.text(*(0.72*particle - 0.18*etheta), r"$r$", color=BLUE, ha="center", va="center")
arc_radius = 0.73 ax.add_patch(Arc( origin, 2*arc_radius, 2*arc_radius, theta1=0, theta2=np.degrees(theta), color=INK, linewidth=1.15, )) ax.text(0.98*np.cos(theta/2), 0.98*np.sin(theta/2), r"$\theta$", ha="center", va="center")
unit_length = 1.04 radial_end = particle + unit_length*er transverse_end = particle + unit_length*etheta arrow(ax, particle, radial_end, TEAL, linewidth=1.9, mutation_scale=13) arrow(ax, particle, transverse_end, TEAL, linewidth=1.9, mutation_scale=13) ax.plot(*particle, marker="o", color=INK, markersize=4.5, zorder=5) ax.text(*(radial_end + np.array([0.10, 0.04])), r"$\mathbf{e}_r$", color=TEAL, va="center") ax.text(*(transverse_end + np.array([-0.13, 0.13])), r"$\mathbf{e}_{\theta}$", color=TEAL, ha="right", va="center")
# Right-angle marker between the two local unit directions. s = 0.17 corner = np.array([ particle + s*er, particle + s*(er + etheta), particle + s*etheta, ]) ax.plot(corner[:, 0], corner[:, 1], color=TEAL, linewidth=1.0)
# Adjacent infinitesimal-rotation schematic, with the angular separation # visually enlarged. The differential formula below is exact. small = fig.add_axes([0.675, 0.39, 0.305, 0.43]) small.set_aspect("equal") small.set_xlim(-0.14, 1.42) small.set_ylim(-0.18, 1.28) small.axis("off")
a = 0.15 da = 0.34 u = np.array([np.cos(a), np.sin(a)]) v = np.array([np.cos(a + da), np.sin(a + da)])
small.add_patch(Arc( (0, 0), 2, 2, theta1=np.degrees(a)-4, theta2=np.degrees(a+da)+8, color=SLATE, linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.45, )) arrow(small, (0, 0), u, BLUE, linewidth=1.6, mutation_scale=11) arrow(small, (0, 0), v, TEAL, linewidth=1.6, mutation_scale=11) arrow(small, u, v, INK, linewidth=1.4, mutation_scale=10)
small.add_patch(Arc( (0, 0), 0.88, 0.88, theta1=np.degrees(a), theta2=np.degrees(a+da), color=INK, linewidth=1.0, )) small.text(0.58*np.cos(a + da/2), 0.58*np.sin(a + da/2) + 0.10, r"$\mathrm{d}\theta$", ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=10) small.text(0.98, -0.02, r"$\mathbf{e}_r(\theta)$", color=BLUE, ha="center", va="top", fontsize=11) small.text(0.78, 0.69, r"$\mathbf{e}_r(\theta+\mathrm{d}\theta)$", color=TEAL, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=11) small.text(1.06, 0.34, r"$\mathrm{d}\mathbf{e}_r$", ha="left", va="center", fontsize=11) small.plot(0, 0, "o", color=INK, markersize=3)
fig.text( 0.815, 0.285, r"$\mathrm{d}\mathbf{e}_r=\mathrm{d}\theta\,\mathbf{e}_{\theta}$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=13, )
